To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) the introduction of information technology (2) is a complex, (3) interconnected systemic process (4) which is (5) crucial to the eventual (6) success or (7) failure of an IT Project.

the management of information technology introduction in a systemic context is crucial to the success of an IT project and that the failure to carry out such analyses may result in the failure of the IT project.
a systemic approach is necessary to the management of information technology introduction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the introduction of information technologies is managed in the systemic context.
the identification of the systemic context in which an enterprise operates and how that context may be analysed.
the management of change, in the context of IT introduction, and the identification of the key elements of such a process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the introduction of IT into an enterprise is a systemic process.
the introduction of information technologies is a highly complex process.
the management of IT introduction is a complex systemic process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a broad systemic analysis should be carried out prior to the implementation of an IT project in order to ensure that a suitable IT system is introduced.
a systemic analysis of the introduction of information technology is essential to the success of any IT project.
a systemic approach to the management of the introduction of IT into an organisation is a prerequisite for success.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the management of IT projects must take a broad systemic view, and must take into account the potential consequences of the failure of the enterprise to successfully carry out various critical analyses, including the analysis of the enterprise’s current situation and the analysis of the various options available to the enterprise.
the introduction of information technology is an interconnected process.
the management of IT introduction is a complex process that requires the application of a broad spectrum of skills.
